matches.why: Torsion-free group counterexample to Kaplansky's conjecture on zero divisors; related Kaplansky/surjunctivity circle of questions on group algebras.
Constructs injective non-surjective cellular automata on K^G, refuting Gottschalk's surjunctivity conjecture.
Gives a finitely presented nonsofic group (G is nonsofic since sofic groups are surjunctive/directly finite).
Disproves the little finitistic dimension conjecture, a homological conjecture for finite-dimensional algebras.
Counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten, Tachikawa, Nakayama and related homological conjectures for Artin algebras.
Eisenbud–Green–Harris concerns Hilbert functions of ideals containing regular sequences, closely related to Hilbert functions of forms.
Kurosh-type algebraicity problem for division rings, in the same circle of ring-theoretic nil/algebraic problems.
Alperin weight conjecture is a block-theoretic local-global counting conjecture closely related to Dade's conjecture.
Local-global counting conjecture in the same family as McKay; Alperin weight proof may bear on it.
Block theory finiteness conjecture (Donovan) in the same area as Dade's conjecture on blocks.
Saxl's conjecture concerns Kronecker coefficients (tensor squares of symmetric group irreps) being positive.
